verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a single config file is a community mention of a netlify.toml file with a [dev] section, plus a separate mention of 'simple redirect config'. That shows Netlify has its own project config file, but nothing shows it defines the whole architecture (functions, databases, storage, env, domains), and the same user reports unclear docs for it. Missing for 10: first-party docs that netlify.toml declares the full architecture (functions, Netlify Database, Blobs, env vars, domains), evidence that one file drives deploys, documented versioning of that config alongside code, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file

citations.quote: no clear docs on what to put in the [dev] section of netlify.toml
simple redirect config - zero javascript, zero nginx, zero S3 settings
